parameters.query: SELECT $1::text AS message_id, $2::text AS subject, $3::text AS from_text, $4::text AS body_text, (m.message_id IS NOT NULL) AS already_processed FROM (SELECT 1) d LEFT JOIN gmail_messages m ON m.message_id = $1

parameters.jsCode:
const j = $json;
return { json: { message_id: j.message_id, subject: j.subject, from_text: j.from_text, classification: j.classification, company: j.company, role: j.role, deadline: j.deadline, invalid: false } };

parameters.query: SELECT id AS matched_posting_id, company AS matched_company, role AS matched_role, similarity(norm_company, $1) AS match_similarity FROM postings WHERE $1 != '' AND similarity(norm_company, $1) > 0.35 ORDER BY match_similarity DESC LIMIT 1

INSERT INTO applications (posting_id, status, updated_at, notes) SELECT $1, $2, now(), $3 WHERE $1 IS NOT NULL ON CONFLICT (posting_id) DO UPDATE SET status = EXCLUDED.status, updated_at = now(), notes = EXCLUDED.notes RETURNING posting_id

parameters.jsCode:
const j = $json;
return { json: { message_id: j.message_id, classification: j.classification, company: j.company, role: j.role, deadline: j.deadline, invalid: j.invalid || false, matched_posting_id: null, match_similarity: null } };

parameters.query: INSERT INTO gmail_messages (message_id, classification, company, role, deadline, matched_posting_id, match_similarity, invalid) VALUES ($1, $2, $3, $4, $5, $6, $7, $8) ON CONFLICT (message_id) DO NOTHING RETURNING message_id
INSERT INTO runs (workflow, started_at, finished_at, fetched, notified) VALUES ('WF-4', now(), now(), $1, $2) RETURNING id
